simple.meaning: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen , begin , plough , carve
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּתַח (H6605) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 145 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּתַח (pâthach) means to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen , begin , plough , carve First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 7 36.

definitions.short: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen , begin , plough , carve
definitions.usage: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.
definitions.full: H6605. pathach I. מָּתַח verb open (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician פתח ; Assyrian pitû, patû ; Sabean פתח Os ZMG xix (1865), 197 ; Arabic ; Ethiopic ; Aramaic מְּתַח , ; Nabataean, Palmyrene פתח ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳פ 2Kin 15:16 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְתַּח Exod 21:33 +; 3 masculine plural suffix יִפְתָּחוּם Neh 13:19 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular מְּתַחִ 2Kin 13:17 +; feminine singular מִּתְחִיּ Song 5:2 ; masculine plural מִּתְחוּ Josh 10:22 +; Infinitive absolute מָּתֹחַ Deut 15:8 +; construct לִפְתֹח Ezek 21:27 +; Participle active מֹּתֵחַ Judg 3:25 +; pass . מָּתוּחַ Jer 5:16 +, etc.; — open sack, שַׂק , Gen 42:27 (E), אַמְתַּחַת 43:21 ; 44:11 (J), skin-bottle ( נאוד ). Judg 4:19 , hamper ( תֵּדָה ) Exod 2:6 (E), pit ( בּוֺר ) 21:33 (E; i. e. uncover it), mouth ( מִּי ) of cave Josh 10:22 (JE), grave Ezek 37:12-13 , (to bring forth dead), of. (in figurative) Jer 5:16 ; Psa 5:10 ; פָתוּחַ כְּלִי Num 19:15 ; (P) open vessel ; door ( דֶּלֶת ; sometimes opposed to סָגַר ) Judg 3:25 + 3:25 (object omitted), 19:27 ; 1Sam 3:15 ; 2Kin 9:3 , 10 ; 2Chr 29:3 ; Job 31:32 (c. ל person); figurative of Leb. of ׳י ), compare open בָּ֑ר , expose for sale, Amos 8:5 ; open womb, i.e. grant offspring Gen 29:31 ; 30:22 (J); open mouth ( מֶּה ) to cry, speak Ezek 21:27 ; Job 3:1 ; Dan 10:16 , hence = speak Isa 53:7 (twice in verse); Job 33:2 ; Psa 39:10 ; 78:2 ( בְּמָשָׁל ), 109:2 (with עַל person), Prov 24:7 ; 31:8 (with ל person), 31:9 ; 31:26 ( בְּחָכְמָה ); Psa 49:5 either utter, declare, propound riddle, or open up, expound ; 1Kin 8:52 ; Neh 1:6 , with ל 2Chr 6:40 (by zeugma), 7:15 (all of ׳י 's favour); open hand, in giving Deut 15:8 , 11 (c, ל person, + infinitive absolute), of ׳י Psa 104:28 ; 145:16 ; book Neh 8:5 (twice in verse), letter 6:5 ; open river (channel) Isa 41:18 (of ׳י ), rock, letting out water, Psa 105:41 ( id. ); open sword, = draw it Ezekiel 21:33; 37:14 ; of root אֱלֵימָֿ֑יִם פָתוּחַ שָׁרְשִׁי Job 29:19 , i.e. with no obstacle intervening. — אֶרֶץ תִּפְתַּח Isa 45:8 is dubious; verb not elsewhere intransitive; Du Che Hpt Marti proposes רַחְמָהּ as object; Gr Kit (in Di) read תִּמָּתַח . Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִפְתַּח Isa 5:27 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִמָּתַח Ezek 24:27 , יִמָּתֵ֑חַ 44:2 +, etc.; Infinitive construct הִמָּתֵחַ Isa 51:14 ; Participle נִפְתָּח Zech 13:1 ; — be opend , of girdle Isa 5:27 (i.e. loosened), compare of captive 51:14 , and, of calamity, Jer 1:14 be let loose (with עַל person); gates Nahum 2:7 ; 3:13 (of land, thrown open to ( ל ) enemy), Ezek 44:2 ; 46:1 (twice in verse); Neh 7:3 ; impersonal of man shut in by God Job 12:14 ; of windows of heaven Gen 7:11 (P), compare Isa 24:18 (of future destruction); the heavens themselves Ezek 1:1 (for visions); fountain Zech 13:1 ; wine (-skin, with negative) Job 32:19 ; mouth, in speech Job 24:27; 33:22 ; ears Isa 35:5 . Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular מִּתַּח Job 30:11 +, מִּתֵּ֑חַ 12:18 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפַתַּח ; Isa 28:24 , 1 singular אֲפַתֵּחַ 45:1 , etc.; — Infinitive abs מַּתֵּחַ 58:6 construct, id. Psa 102:21 ; Participle מְפַתֵּ֑חַ 1Kin 20:11 ; — loose: 1 free , i.e. ungird, camels Gen 24:32 (J): loins of kings Isa 45:1 (i.e. disarm them); set free , with suffix person Psa 105:20 ; Jer 40:4 (with מִן ); with accusative תְמוּתָה בְּנֵי Psa 102:21 . 2 loosen (and remove) sack-cloth Isa 20:2 (c. מֵעַל ), Psa 30:12 ; armour 1Kin 20:11 (object omitted; opposed to חָגַר ); bonds Job 12:18 ; Psa 116:16 , compare Isa 58:6 ; Job 39:5 ; cord 30:11 ; 38:11 ; loosen ground Isa 28:24 (in tillage; compare Vogelst Land wrirthschaft 38 , Assyrian puttû ). 3 open gates Isa 60:11 , doors Job 41:6 (figurative of crocodile's jaws); ear Isa 48:8 (read probably either מָּתַחְתִּי מִּתַּחְתִּי, [ ᵐ5 Du Marti], or נִפְתְּחָה [Gr Che Kit in Di]; buds Cant 7:13 (of blossom; object omitted; or intransitive, as sometimes Arabic see Dozy). Hithpa`el Imperative masculine plural התפתחו Isa 52:2 Kt < Qr feminine singular הִתְמַּתְּחִי (so ᵐ5 ; of personified Jerusalem) loosen thee (Ges § 54f ) the fetters of thy neck . II. [ מָּתַח ] verb Pi`el engrave (Late Hebrew Pi`el id. , מִּתּוּחַ = Biblical Hebrew, and so ᵑ7 ; Assyrian patâ—u , bore, penetrate ; compare perhaps Arabic , ring (compare Frä 252 )); — Perfect 3masculine singular מִּתַּח 2Chr 3:7 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְפַתַּח 1Kin 7:36 ; 2 masculine singular תְּפַתַּח Exod 28:11 ; Infinitive construct לְפַתֵּחַ 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:13 ; Participle מְפַתֵּחַ Zech 3:9 ; — engrave , with accusative + על , on metal 1Kin 7:36 ; 2Chr 3:7 ; Exod 28:36 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb חוֺתָם מִּתּוּחֵי ), on stone 28:9 ; with accusative אֶבֶן + accusative of congnate meaning with verb 28:11 (all P); with accusative of congnate meaning with verb only, Zech 3:9 (on stone), and, in General, 2Chr 2:6 ; 2:13 . Pu`al Participle feminine plural חוֺתָם פִתּוּחֵי מְפֻתָּחֹת Exod 39:9 (P) stones engraved with the engravings of signet .
